title: UDS: Cleanup and rework
description:
Updates:
- DSC:   Add support for P2 Timers

- RDBI:  Cleanup, detect more errors
- SA:    Support more SubFunctions
- CDTCS: Parse more of the message
- WDBI:  Detect more errors
- RC:    Cleanup and parse record
- TD:    Data Record supported

Rename type to SubFunction as the standard specifies.

commits_data.message:
UDS: Cleanup and rework

Updates:
- DSC:   Add support for P2 Timers
- ER:    Add support for Downtime and fix name
- RDBI:  Cleanup, detect more errors
- SA:    Support more SubFunctions
- CDTCS: Parse more of the message
- WDBI:  Detect more errors
- RC:    Cleanup and parse record
- TD:    Data Record supported
- TP:    Show SubFunction with suppress flag as subtree
- RD:    Cleanup of naming

Rename type to SubFunction as the standard specifies.
